title: 毕业项目：注册表单校验器
description:
把前四章拼成一个真实功能：实现 validateSignup(payload)，返回 { ok, errors }。payload 含 name / email / password / birthdate 四个字段；errors 只包含出错的字段，值是稳定的错误码。

规则：
1) name：去掉首尾空格后长度 2–40，否则 name_invalid。
2) email：满足简单邮箱形状（本地部@域名.后缀），否则 email_invalid。
3) password：至少 8 位，且同时含小写、大写、数字和符号 !@#$%^&* 中至少一个，否则 password_weak。
4) birthdate：YYYY-MM-DD 的真实日期（2020-02-30 不合法），不能晚于 2026-11-10，且以 2026-11-10 为基准年满 13 岁（生日不晚于 2013-11-10）。错误码依次为 birthdate_invalid / birthdate_future / birthdate_too_young。

验收：12 条测试表达式全过；返回对象的 ok 与 errors 必须同时正确。

tests.name: 完整合法表单通过
tests.expr: validateSignup({ name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@example.com', password: 'Str0ng!pass', birthdate: '2010-12-10' }).ok === true

tests.name: 口令缺大写/数字/符号被拒
刚满 13 岁通过（边界）
tests.expr: validateSignup({ name: 'Ada', email: 'ada@example.com', password: 'Str0ng!pass', birthdate: '2013-11-10' }).ok === true

tests.name: 空对象四个字段全部报错
tests.name_en: Empty object reports all four fields

tests.name: 邮箱缺少后缀点号被拒
tests.name_en: Email missing the suffix dot rejected

hints: 先写一个 isValidDateString：用 Date.UTC 构造日期，再回读年/月/日确认没有被滚动。
把四个字段的校验写成分段 if，错误码只在失败时写入 errors；最后用 Object.keys(errors).length === 0 计算 ok。
年龄边界用 Date.UTC 比较时间戳：生日时间戳大于 2013-11-10 就未满 13 岁，等于则刚好通过。
explanation: 这题的关键不是把四个规则堆在一起，而是让错误码稳定、边界可验证。日期用 UTC 回读法处理 2 月 30 日、闰年等滚动问题；年龄用固定基准日 2026-11-10 比较时间戳，避免运行环境时区影响。
description_en:
Combine the first four chapters into one real feature: implement validateSignup(payload) returning { ok, errors }. payload has name / email / password / birthdate; errors contains only the invalid fields, each value a stable error code.

Rules:
1) name: 2-40 characters after trimming, otherwise name_invalid.
2) email: a simple email shape (local@domain.suffix), otherwise email_invalid.
3) password: at least 8 characters with at least one lowercase, uppercase, digit and symbol from !@#$%^&*, otherwise password_weak.
4) birthdate: a real YYYY-MM-DD date (2020-02-30 is invalid), not after 2026-11-10, and at least 13 years old relative to 2026-11-10 (birthday on or before 2013-11-10). Error codes in order: birthdate_invalid / birthdate_future / birthdate_too_young.

Acceptance: all 12 test expressions pass; both ok and errors must be correct.
hints_en: Write isValidDateString first: construct the date with Date.UTC, then read year/month/day back to confirm it did not roll over.
Write the four field checks as separate if blocks; write an error code only when a check fails; compute ok with Object.keys(errors).length === 0.
Use Date.UTC timestamps for the age boundary: a birthday after 2013-11-10 means under 13; equality passes.
explanation_en: The point is not to pile four rules together but to keep error codes stable and boundaries testable. Dates use the UTC read-back trick for 30 February and leap years; age compares timestamps against the fixed reference date 2026-11-10, so the runtime time zone does not matter.
